name: 仙剑奇侠传 (nitan170911)
english_description: The largest of the 'nitan' (NT/Lonely) engine family games in this collection, weighing in at roughly 54,000 files. Set in the world of the beloved Chinese Paladin / Sword and Fairy (Xianjian Qixia Zhuan) game and TV franchise, it shares its core attribute-storage architecture with its smaller sibling nitan6 (Laughing in the Wind). Its account system depends on an external MySQL server for cross-site character syncing, so in this archived environment new registration is gracefully declined rather than broken — it's best explored by browsing the code and world content rather than played start to finish.
